description: List all five built-in specialist multi-agent wings (architect, reviewer, qa, security, ops), their isolated wing:<id> namespaces, and active memory counts (read-only, idempotent; consumes 1 Read API call) and return { wings }. Always returns all five wings even when memory_count is 0. Use to inspect wing responsibilities and queued handoff volume before delegating work; use handoff_to_agent to record a new cross-wing handoff, or stats to inspect a custom project namespace.

namespace.description: Optional logical workspace namespace context (never prefix with "org:").

name: list_agent_wings

wings.description: Array of { id, label, description, namespace, memory_count } wing descriptors.

title: List Specialist Agent Wings
